title: Maharashtra RTI Online portal
issuer: General Administration Department, Government of Maharashtra
provision: Portal scope, authority directory, filing stages and payment methods
excerpt: The portal supports applications and first appeals for listed Maharashtra Government authorities, excludes Central and other State authorities, and lists Internet banking and card payments.
notes: The live portal also publishes 2026-rule material, which is excluded from the v1 legacy baseline and deferred to v2 under project policy.

technical.notes: Current portal scope and public-authority directory inspected.

legalRti.notes: Review operational use separately from the deferred 2026 legal material.
